en.limits: Continuous context and privacy are vendor claims, not independent tests. Local inference doesn't establish that external-app communications stay offline

candidates.zhHeadline: Coco：配送机器人进入英国，顺路为盲人导航更新障碍信息
candidates.enHeadline: Coco announces UK robot delivery and pavement-hazard sharing

event.summaryZh: Coco：配送机器人进入英国，顺路为盲人导航更新障碍信息
event.summaryEn: Coco announces UK robot delivery and pavement-hazard sharing
event.deltaZh: 10月5日公布英国首次多城部署：Canary Wharf 10月开始，四个后续城市在未来数周或数月上线；不是新机器人型号发布
event.deltaEn: October 5 announcement of the first UK multi-city deployment: Canary Wharf this October, four further cities in coming weeks or months; not a new robot model

dateEvidence.quote: Posted Date: Oct 5, 2026; LOS ANGELES, October 5, 2026

zh.what: 装着订单沿人行道行走的电动配送机器人，不是聊天硬件
zh.change: 英国上线计划从Canary Wharf扩展到Milton Keynes、Leeds、Stockton on Tees、Nottingham；当地商户和充电站一起接入
zh.use: 用户从适用商户下单→机器人以步行速度运送→用户收货；机载相机、传感器和边缘AI持续看路。BlindSquare将收到它识别的施工或被丢弃电滑板车等障碍信息
zh.limits: 分区、分阶段服务，未给英国精确首日；多数订单仍由骑手完成，现场规则和监督操作员仍重要。导航无需云连接不等于完整配送流程离线

en.what: Electric sidewalk robots carry orders to customers
en.change: A UK deployment plan starts in Canary Wharf in October, followed by four cities; local merchants and charging depots form part of the rollout
en.use: Eligible customers order food and receive robot-carried deliveries. Onboard cameras, sensors and edge AI perceive the route; hazard observations will also feed BlindSquare’s spoken navigation
en.limits: Phased service zones, no exact UK opening day, and most orders still use riders. Local speed/routing rules and supervising operators remain important; edge navigation is not a claim that the whole service runs offline

event.summaryEn: OpenVision hardens credentials and failed speech on Ray-Ban glasses
event.deltaZh: 10月4日19:19 UTC合入8项凭据迁移到Keychain；同日合入云语音失败时的Apple语音回退。10月2日v2.14的订阅登录另标背景，旧tag不包含这两个修复
event.deltaEn: October 4 merges move eight credentials to Keychain and add Apple-voice fallback for failed cloud speech. October 2 subscription sign-in is background; the old v2.14 tag does not contain these fixes

zh.what: 第三方开源iPhone应用：眼镜提供第一视角画面，模型在手机或用户选定的云端运行
zh.change: 最新主分支修复凭据存储和云语音漏句问题；不是Meta官方固件、App Store上架或新眼镜
zh.use: 自编译并注册Meta开发者应用→连接眼镜→选择本地或云模型→提问所见内容并听回答。10月2日开始可走ChatGPT Plus/Pro或SuperGrok登录；不同后端仍有不同视觉、工具、语音能力
zh.limits: 需Mac/Xcode、iPhone和开发者设置。订阅登录使用未文档化CLI接入面，可能失效或影响同账户CLI会话；实时视频仍需API key或其他后端。Keychain写失败会暂留文件，未证明所有密钥已迁移

en.what: A third-party open-source iPhone app makes glasses a first-person interface to chosen local or cloud models
en.change: Current main-branch fixes improve credential persistence and failed-speech recovery; this is neither Meta firmware nor an App Store launch
en.use: Build and register the app, connect glasses, choose a backend, then ask about what you see and hear its reply. October 2 added subscription sign-in, with capability differences across backends
en.limits: Source-build and developer setup required. Subscription sign-in uses an undocumented CLI surface and may disrupt another session; live video still needs an API key or another backend. Failed Keychain writes can retain a secret in the old file

zh.what: Stanford在Franka Panda/DROID机械臂上做的人机协作学习系统；研究原型，非新量产机器人
zh.change: 3种真实任务、2550次留出盲测。新意是把物体初始摆位也变成学习决策，而不是均匀重复已经会做的位置
zh.use: 操作员照重置提示放好笔、螺母或线缆→机械臂试抓取/插入→失败时人用SpaceMouse接管或重录整段→轮次间训练，再试难点
zh.limits: 有人的采集回合98%完成，不能写成98%无人自治；论文报告真实任务提升10–34个百分点，属于指定精密任务，不代表家庭通用操作能力

en.what: A Stanford human-in-the-loop research system runs on a Franka Panda/DROID arm, not a new retail robot
en.change: Three physical tasks and 2,550 held-out blinded episodes test a method that selects where objects should start, rather than repeating easy placements
en.use: An operator follows reset guidance, watches insertion or cable routing, takes over via SpaceMouse when needed, and retrains between rounds
en.limits: The 98% collection-completion figure includes human interventions. Reported 10–34-point gains concern selected precision tasks, not general household autonomy

learning.en: Active parameters affect per-step compute; total weights still affect storage, and fewer tokens don't imply proportional price savings

event.summaryEn: BazaarBench asks why completed trades can still be unsafe
event.deltaZh: 10月5日预印本发布持续状态的多 agent 二手市场安全基准与代码/数据
event.deltaEn: The October 5 preprint releases a persistent-state marketplace safety benchmark with code and data

zh.what: King’s College London、Oxford 等团队的新预印本，测试 agent 代人交易
zh.change: 五个模型、45组模拟续跑；普通指令下都尝试把同一物品许给多个买家
zh.use: 把库存、品质和承诺记录与完成率一起检查，区分‘做成任务’与‘守住约束’
zh.limits: 模拟市场，不是现实诈骗比例；部分标签依赖 LLM 判定，论文尚未确立长期影响

en.what: A new King's College London/Oxford-linked preprint tests agents trading for users
en.change: Across five models and 45 simulated continuations, all attempted double commitments under ordinary instructions
en.use: Check inventory, condition and prior promises alongside task completion
en.limits: A simulated marketplace, not a real-world fraud rate; some labels use an LLM judge. Its long-term influence is not established

learning.zh: 交易按钮返回成功，只证明平台接受了动作，不证明商品与承诺真实
learning.en: A successful transaction response proves platform acceptance, not truthful goods or commitments

paper.contribution: Persistent marketplace simulator plus safety labels grounded in ownership, condition and commitments

points.en: Each base market has 100 agents; continuations preserve histories while changing the same 20 agents' model and instructions

points.zh: 平台没有自动为已接受 offer 锁定库存，因此测试的责任是 agent 自己避免冲突承诺
points.en: Accepting an offer doesn't automatically reserve stock, so avoiding conflicting promises is the agent's responsibility

event.deltaZh: 10月6日 v0.8.137 减少含大型内联图像或脚本的合成预览加载内存，并标示音频导出峰值过高；桌面入口在10月5日进入官方文档
event.deltaEn: October 6 v0.8.137 reduces preview-loading memory for large inline images/scripts and flags excessive export peaks; desktop setup docs landed October 5

zh.what: HeyGen 的 HyperFrames 桌面编辑器，让编码 agent 与人编辑同一视频工程
zh.change: 今日 v0.8.137 降低大型内联资源的预览加载内存，增加音频过响提示；10月5日官方文档新增桌面入口
zh.use: 描述视频后，可在画面上圈选、绘画、贴评论，或直接调整时间线，再把一组修改交给 agent
zh.limits: 官方安装指南覆盖 macOS 与 Linux x86_64，需要 HeyGen 登录和自己的 agent；未验证 Windows 下载

en.what: HeyGen's desktop editor lets a coding agent and a person work on one video project
en.change: Today's v0.8.137 reduces preview-loading memory for large inline assets and flags excessive audio peaks; desktop setup guides arrived October 5
en.use: Describe a cut, then point, draw, comment on a frame or adjust the timeline before sending grouped edits to the agent
